current_runtime_profile.name: current
current_runtime_profile.identity_authority: The current source manifest supplies source/ELF hashes, function inventory and complete ordered compilation units; actual execution requires its matching cold-build receipt.

bounded_types.0: IEEE binary32 Tensor: documented arithmetic, AD and conversion paths
bounded_types.1: Bool Tensor with one-byte elements: documented typed/logical/reduction paths
bounded_types.2: signed int64 Tensor with eight-byte elements: documented typed/integer/mixed/reduction paths
bounded_types.3: internal rank-zero wrapped IEEE binary64 Scalar only; no general F64 Tensor service
bounded_types.4: Public binary64 selected storage, conversion and dense no-grad logical paths, plus numeric predicates. Direct requires_grad construction and direct as_strided remain explicit boundaries; this is not general F64 Tensor parity.
bounded_types.5: Public F16 storage/copy/fill, selected F32 conversion, dense no-grad any/all/Bool sum and numeric predicates. Ordinary Half arithmetic and AD remain outside the current contract.
bounded_types.6: Public BF16 storage/copy/fill, selected F32 conversion, dense no-grad any/all/Bool sum and numeric predicates. Conversion NaN payload behavior is under independent audit; no full Half arithmetic, AD or dtype parity is claimed.

resource_bounds.storage: Documented nonnegative strides, offsets and empty layouts; distinct allocation, work and pool limits still apply.
resource_bounds.scope: These finite implementation caps are not PyTorch limits and are not all simultaneously attainable.

115.scope: Admitted source/result combinations only. Bool/I64-to-F32 converts each element before F32 reduction. Explicit Bool sum includes public dense no-grad F64/F16/BF16. Empty axis tuple reduces all dimensions. Floating requires_grad plus Bool output is refused after axis validation.

new_command_contracts.reduction_common: Rank0..4 and <=262144 logical elements; signed axes, keepdim0/1, zero reserved words, complete bounded axis payload. Scalar axis0/-1 is accepted. No out= or unimplemented dtype/backend contract is inferred.

120.arguments: word1 is the public Tensor capability; words2..7 must be zero
120.result: Input shape; independent owned Bool Tensor/Storage/Version; detached, with no AD, Saved, view or source-retaining edges.
120.scope: Rank0..4, at most262144 logical elements, and admitted source construction/layout contracts. Direct public F64/Half as_strided and Half AD are not added by this command.

current_image_qualification.success_rule: All20 groups must execute anew and pass with the exact current source, main ELF and actual cold-build receipt. Generator131 separately links and executes current-object ABI and reordered probe images. Every original numerical comparison, control, denominator, source inverse, owner/transport readback, actual resource recovery, process exit, both EOFs and unchanged-input binding remains mandatory. Protocol/error controls are not successful Torch compatibility cases.

half47.conversion_NaN_comparison: NaN classification; non-NaN conversion values and same-dtype clone/set/fill retain their original bitwise checks. This does not establish all NaN payload conversions.

current_image_qualification.image_scope: One main production image plus separately identified Generator ABI/reordered probe images.
current_image_qualification.cold_build_scope: PASS_NATIVE_BUILD_ONLY and source preparation do not establish runtime qualification.

controls_required.other_controls: All original Bool/Integral dtype observations, F32 dtype/axis/entry controls and both conversion/output allocation stages remain mandatory. Explicitly superseded refusal results retain their original FAIL records.

current_runtime_profile.reference_policy: Fixed independently produced reference bytes or the exact pinned live Torch CPU interpreter; no native-result-derived expected values.

pending_audit_findings.scope: Potential special-NaN payload differences in the existing F32-to-BF16 to() conversion require isolated native/reference reproduction. Existing Half47 conversion comparisons classify NaNs; predicates classify directly supplied raw bits and do not use this conversion.

capabilities.name: tensor-arithmetic
capabilities.scope: Selected CPU F32 pointwise add/subtract/multiply/divide with right-aligned broadcasting; scoped Bool/I64 and mixed-type paths are separate, explicit contracts.

capabilities.name: unary-and-softmax
capabilities.scope: F32 ReLU/neg/sqrt/exp/log/sigmoid/tanh and single-axis softmax/log-softmax in the documented bounded layouts.

capabilities.name: sum-and-mean
capabilities.scope: Existing F32 reductions and command115 sum with None, empty or signed axis tuples and keepdim; Bool/I64 outputs and explicit conversion to F32 are bounded, separately tested paths.

capabilities.name: logical-reductions
capabilities.scope: Commands118 any and119 all admit Bool, I64, F32, rank-zero wrapped F64 and public dense no-grad F64/F16/BF16. HIA truth conversion, reduction and independent detached Bool allocation are implemented. Empty axis tuples mean no reduction; empty reductions retain their operation identity.

capabilities.name: bool-sum
capabilities.scope: Command115 explicit Bool sum includes public dense no-grad F64/F16/BF16 with the other admitted source types. Empty axis tuples mean all dimensions. Axis errors precede the floating requires_grad refusal; Half AD is not implemented.

capabilities.name: matmul
capabilities.scope: Rank1..4 vector/matrix/broadcast-batched F32 products, selected strided/empty inputs and broadcast-reduced first-order reverse gradients; mm remains rank2-only.

capabilities.name: typed-storage-and-views
capabilities.scope: Real byte-wide Bool, eight-byte I64 and four-byte F32 Storage; selected typed construction/read/fill/casts, transpose, as_strided, view and reshape, alias identity and shared Version behavior. Wrapped F64 remains scalar-only.

capabilities.name: first-order-autograd
capabilities.scope: Explicit or implicit F32 seeds, leaf and selected retained gradients, Saved/Version checks, captured mutation history, scoped mixed F32/I64 gradients and original partial-backward behavior; no full forward/higher-order AD.

capabilities.name: linear-and-losses
capabilities.scope: Selected F32 Linear, broadcast mean-squared loss and rank-two probability-target cross entropy; unsupported overloads and options remain outside the profile.

capabilities.name: convolution-and-pooling
capabilities.scope: Bounded NCHW/OIHW conv2d with documented groups/stride/dilation/padding and floor avg/max pool variants; no complete module or backend coverage.

capabilities.name: normalization
capabilities.scope: Last-dimension LayerNorm and selected evaluation BatchNorm with explicit affine/statistics contracts.

capabilities.name: indexing-and-scatter
capabilities.scope: Selected F32 index_select, gather, scatter_add and index_add with signed-I64 index payloads, duplicate accumulation, empty handling and explicit failure contracts.

capabilities.name: cat-and-stack
capabilities.scope: Documented rank1..4 F32 cat and rank0..3-to-rank1..4 stack, repeated-parent VJP, qualified layout selection and skipped rank-one empty cat gradient accumulation.

capabilities.name: tensor-object-lifetime
capabilities.scope: Owned Tensor/Storage/Version/Weak/Saved/Hold objects, revocable public capabilities, ViewInfo roots, gradient aliases, growing pools and source-bound reset/reference equations.

capabilities.name: optimizers-and-training
capabilities.scope: Selected SGD, momentum/Nesterov and owned Adam/AdamW state/update paths with documented gradient-presence behavior and finite training trajectories; full optimizer/scheduler/API parity is open.

capabilities.name: rng-and-distributions
capabilities.scope: Native CPU MT19937 Generators with complete5056-byte state, selected distributions and explicit partial errors. Generator131 retains original24/native11/entry59/dispatch37, real entropy and separately executed current-object ABI/reordered probes. All-distribution and all-device parity remain open.

capabilities.name: public-f64-original-paths
capabilities.scope: Bounded public dense no-gradient F64 paths with all original 33 numeric, 12 boundary, 1 entry and 2 allocation recipes retained. This is not complete F64 arithmetic, layout or AD parity.

capabilities.name: half-storage-and-conversion
capabilities.scope: Public F16/BF16 storage, selected same-dtype alias/copy/fill and F32 narrow/widen conversion paths. Original Half47 and its239 refusal controls remain required. Separate logical264 and transaction12 cover the new dense no-grad logical extension. Conversion NaN classification does not establish full payload equivalence; ordinary Half arithmetic and AD remain open.

capabilities.name: numeric-predicates
capabilities.scope: Commands120..124 implement isnan/isinf/isfinite/isposinf/isneginf for admitted dtype0..6 and rank0..4 inputs by native bit classification. Each result is an independent detached Bool tensor with the same shape. Existing source construction, layout, resource and gradient boundaries remain in force.

unimplemented_subsystems: Complete frontend, dispatcher, overloads, contexts and public API compatibility
Full contracts for all 2590 native declarations and 688 derivative declarations
General dtype promotion/casting, complex/quantized/sparse/nested layouts and every device variant
Higher-order/create_graph, forward AD, hooks and full transform/alias/mutation semantics
All NN modules, optimizers, schedulers and complete state/mode behavior
Checkpoint/state serialization, compatibility and interrupted/distributed restoration
CUDA/ROCm/MPS/XPU and all device allocation, transfers, streams and kernels
Distributed process groups, collectives, DDP/FSDP/DTensor and failure semantics
PyTorch graph capture, symbolic shapes, compile/export and artifact compatibility
Dataset/dataloader, workers, multiprocessing, sampling and cancellation
All required platforms, packaging, extension/profiling interfaces and final whole-project acceptance
historical_metadata_policy: Current capability descriptions refer to the one canonical source. The single published baseline record and immutable original evidence retain earlier identities; no historical PASS qualifies this candidate. Process-version narratives are retained in Git history.
